target_customer: Enterprise physical security teams at large companies, campuses and schools
problem: Security teams cannot watch thousands of camera feeds, so incidents are found after the fact and motion alerts are mostly false alarms.
business_model: Enterprise software subscription sold direct and through security integrators and resellers

founders.name: Shikhar Shrestha
founders.background_notes: Education per a16z post; the post says a gunpoint robbery shaped his motivation.

founders.name: Vikesh Khanna
founders.background_notes: Prior employers per YC page bio.

competitors.name: Matroid
competitors.what: Customer trained detectors that monitor video streams

competitors.name: Deep Sentinel
competitors.what: Deep learning home security with live guards

technical_complexity.rationale: Reasoning about camera video in real time across existing cameras needed strong computer vision research and scarce labeled security data in 2017.

defensibility.rationale: Models, deployments on enterprise camera and access systems and reseller deals create friction, but large camera vendors can add analytics.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Camera vendors added analytics over time; Ambient stayed independent and signed reseller deals with Securitas in 2026.

market_need_then: Physical security venture investment was rising (Memoori counted 11 deals worth 121.9M USD in 2017) and camera feeds far outnumbered watchers.

branding.domain_note: Uses the ambient.ai domain. AMBIENT.AI trademark filed July 2017 and registered May 2019 per a trademark database.

identity.voice_and_tone: Enterprise security; tagline Agentic Physical Security for a World that can't wait

brand_strength.rationale: Name is generic and shared with the ambient AI scribe category, but it earned Forbes and Fast Company mentions per its site.

outcome_analysis: Ambient.ai stayed in stealth until its January 2022 public launch with a16z backing, raised about 52M USD across A and B, then took strategic money from Allegion in 2023 and again in 2026 as a Series C. Reseller deals with Securitas and integrators show a repeatable enterprise channel. It remains independent and active.
notes: The 52M figure combines Series A and B per the company press release; the split and exact dates were not found, and the 2022 date is the a16z public launch post, not a stated round date. The company page labels the 2023 round Series C; the article text calls it a strategic growth investment, and a 2026 report calls a new round Series C, so labels conflict. Competitor sources are dated 2017 but cover adjacent products. Founding year conflicts (2016 or 2017). Aggregator total of 146.1M not verified. Stanford affiliation of Khanna not confirmed.
